# Dictionary.com

> Dictionary.com is the web's leading reference for English word definitions, etymology, synonyms, and modern language trends including slang, internet culture, and pop culture vocabulary.

Dictionary.com provides comprehensive word definitions, interactive games, and cultural language content sourced from authoritative dictionaries including Random House Unabridged Dictionary and American Heritage Dictionary. The platform covers traditional vocabulary alongside contemporary slang, trending terms, and internet culture phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Word definitions
- Etymology
- Synonyms
- Slang terms
- Internet culture
- Usage examples
- Idioms
- English language
- Trending words
- Pop culture
- Word games
- Language education
- American English
- Emoji meanings
- Memes

## Core Reference

- [Dictionary.com Homepage](https://www.dictionary.com): Main Dictionary.com homepage with definitions, synonyms, and language tools.
- [Word of the Day](https://www.dictionary.com/word-of-the-day): Daily vocabulary learning feature with word definitions and examples.

## Word Definitions & Etymology

- [EMBARRASS Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/embarrass): Definition, synonyms, etymology, and examples for the word embarrass.
- [EPHEMERAL Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/ephemeral): Dictionary entry for ephemeral with definitions, synonyms, and etymology.
- [VAINGLORY Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/vainglory): Dictionary entry for vainglory with etymology and usage examples.
- [HOPEFULLY Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/hopefully): Definition and usage guide for hopefully with grammar explanations.
- [STOP-START Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/stop-start): Dictionary entry for stop-start with definitions and usage examples.

## Idioms & Expressions

- [BEAT AROUND THE BUSH Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/beat-around-the-bush): Idiom definition and examples for beat around the bush expression.
- [bumper crop](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang/bumper-crop): Definition of bumper crop idiom with literal and figurative usage.

## Modern Language & Slang

- [Language And Culture](https://www.dictionary.com/culture): Modern language section covering slang, emoji, pop culture, and trending terms.
- [CHONKY Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/chonky): Definition and examples of the slang term chonky from internet culture.
- [YOLO Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/yolo): Definition and origin of YOLO slang term popularized by Drake.
- [microshifting](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang/microshifting): Slang definition of microshifting, a modern workplace scheduling practice.
- [cozy mystery](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang/cozy-mystery): Definition of cozy mystery fiction subgenre with characteristics and examples.

## Internet Culture & Memes

- [Leeroy Jenkins](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/memes/leeroy-jenkins): Gaming meme definition from World of Warcraft viral video culture.
- [March Madness](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/historical-current-events/march-madness-meaning): Definition and explanation of March Madness NCAA basketball tournament.

## Games & Interactive Learning

- [Play Free Online Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Word games hub featuring WordFork, WordStrike, 4Words, and ConnectWord.

## Featured Articles & Blog

- [Featured Articles](https://www.dictionary.com/articles): Featured articles on English language trends, word origins, and vocabulary.
- [News from March 14–March 20, 2026](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/news-from-march-14-march-20-2026): Weekly roundup of vocabulary in context from news headlines and pop culture.
- [Words All Book Lovers Should Add to Their Lingo Library](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/words-for-book-lovers): Vocabulary guide for book lovers featuring literary terms and reading culture.
